title: Transient closing-checkpoint witness: assert settlement before the new evaluate and use a distinct uncertain successor grant
outcome: src/tests/engram_closing_checkpoint_retry_transient.rs claims the prior grant is settled before the one new evaluate, but only compares counts. It asserts from CausalTransport.order that the recovery turn_checkpoint (NeverStarted) or the session_status read (LostReply) precedes the new turn_evaluate. Its uncertain-grant case also uses the shape production writes: active = prior grant N, uncertain = a distinct possibly-begun successor grant. The current case sets uncertain == active, a state no production writer produces.
acceptance: The transient witness asserts the settlement (recovery checkpoint or status read) is ordered before the new evaluate for both failure modes, and an uncertain-grant case with a distinct successor grant keeps the hold; the focused tests pass.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
